verses.1: And all the people of Israel came together in that place, near the Sea of Galilee, during the first month. The people gathered in a holy place, and Mary died there. She was buried there.
verses.2: And there would be no water for them to drink. They would gather around Moses and Aaron.
verses.3: And the people grew closer to Moses. They said, “Let us die together in one place, our friends, before Jehovah.”
verses.4: And why have you brought the people of Jehovah to this shore of death? We are dying there, in our own city.
verses.5: And why were we brought out of Egypt to this horrible place? It’s not a place for planting seeds, crops, vines, or trees. It’s also not a place where water can be used for drinking.
verses.6: And Moses and Aaron went before the people to the entrance of the Tabernacle. They fell down before it, and they saw the glory of Jehovah there.
verses.7: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.8: Take the pot and pour the water into it. You and your brother Aaron shall stand before them. Then you shall say to them, “Pour some water from the pot for them.” And you shall bring them water from the pot, and you shall fill the pots with water.
verses.9: And Moses took the staff from before Jehovah, as He commanded him.
verses.10: Moses and Aaron gathered the people together in front of the rock. They said to them, “Listen carefully to what the voices from this rock say; it is a message from God for you.”
verses.11: And Moses stretched out his hand, and he broke the rock in two places. Then many waters gushed out from those places. And the people were saved.
verses.12: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Why didn’t you believe in Me so that I could sanctify You before the eyes of the Israelites? Therefore, you shall not bring this people into the land that I have given them.”
verses.13: What a great cause of strife there is among the children of Israel, which causes them to become like Jehovah’s enemies.
verses.14: And Moses sent angels from heaven to King Adam. He said, “Your brothers, the Israelites, you know all about the plans that were made against us.”
verses.15: Our ancestors came out of Egypt. They lived in Egypt for many years. But they became enemies of us and our ancestors in Egypt.
verses.16: And we cried out to the LORD. He heard our cries. He sent an angel to save us from Egypt. And behold, we are now in a holy city, on your border.
verses.17: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through fields or orchards. We will also not drink water from streams along the king’s road. We will not turn right or left until we have crossed your borders.
verses.18: And Adam said to him, “Do not pass by me; otherwise, I will go and call for help.”
verses.19: And the children of Israel said to him, “In the wilderness we will be weak and exhausted. But if you give us some food, I will go ahead and take what I can carry with me. But there’s nothing in my legs that I can use to walk.”
verses.20: And he said, “Do not pass by.” Then Adam went out to call him, with a great crowd and strong arms.
verses.21: And Adam led Israel across the wilderness. Israel walked upon his back.
verses.22: And they traveled from the holy place, and all of the Israelites arrived at Mount Horeb.
verses.23: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “On Mount Sinai, on the border of the land of Edom, I will speak.”
verses.24: Aaron will be gathered to his people, because he did not come to the land that I gave to the children of Israel. He committed an act of sin by speaking against Me in their midst.
verses.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar, their sons, and place them on that mountain.
verses.26: And he stripped Aaron’s clothes off him, and he also stripped Eleazar of his clothes. Then Aaron died there.
verses.27: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him. They went up to the mountain, before the eyes of all the people.
verses.28: Moses took Aaron’s clothes and wrapped them around Eliezer, his son. Then Aaron died on the mountain. Moses and Eliezer descended from the mountain.
verses.29: And all the people saw that Aaron had died. They mourned for Aaron for thirty days, throughout the entire house of Israel.
